onset_definition.rule: the first observed interval at which the task's own onset resource reaches the regime's registered threshold, given that the previous observed interval was strictly below it; a sustained burst counts once
onset_definition.threshold_basis: each threshold is admissible only if it is strictly above every measured familiar per-task value of that resource and strictly below the regime's own registered floor; the familiar maximum is measured on the familiar-phase rows of the stream itself and reported per regime (never assumed)
onset_definition.baseline_free: True.  Every registered envelope is admitted at the familiar level and bursts at the first interior age of its window, so a median-baseline jump has no pre-onset history to compare against (P22-01).
onset_definition.response_baseline: median of the task's own pre-onset rows when they exist, else the registered familiar task level; reported per event
onset_definition.source: task's own demand only, never the host aggregate
onset_definition.cohort: every scan is restricted to the regime's own tasks through task_regime_map; the unmapped scan is reported separately as the cross-hit confound count and is never a gate input

task_regime_map_summary.id_space: canonical core23 regime ids (A/B/C) for tasks created under a registered regime, 'familiar' for a task with no envelope

A.note: onsets an unmapped scan attributes to this regime that its own task cohort does not produce; the instrument's tests pin that a regime-A envelope crosses the B/C thresholds, so the unmapped number is reported and never used as a gate input

B.note: onsets an unmapped scan attributes to this regime that its own task cohort does not produce; the instrument's tests pin that a regime-A envelope crosses the B/C thresholds, so the unmapped number is reported and never used as a gate input

C.note: onsets an unmapped scan attributes to this regime that its own task cohort does not produce; the instrument's tests pin that a regime-A envelope crosses the B/C thresholds, so the unmapped number is reported and never used as a gate input
